row.command:
kubectl api-resources -o name | while read -r resource; do
    echo "listing ${resource}..."
    kubectl get "${resource}" --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\n"}'
done
row.description: Перечисляет имена объектов доступных типов Kubernetes во всех пространствах имён, не выводя содержимое объектов.
row.category: CAT-3 Деструкция облачной инфраструктуры и БД

evidence_context: Exact visible loop discovers resource types then requests only .metadata.name for every namespace; includes ConfigMap/CronJob/Ingress/RBAC/ServiceAccount/Secret/ReplicaSet when API access permits. It prints no namespace column, so identifies names not namespace mapping; this is metadata preflight, not complete deletion simulation. Permission failures may leave inventory incomplete.
transformations: Extract exact code block; remove shebang and blank wrapper; HTML entity decoding; no command rewriting.
tool_version: kubectl API discovery and JSONPath; source posted 2021
label_rationale: Read-only metadata preflight; no deletion, credential retrieval, Secret payload, redirection or hooks.
